selection_tie_break: lower validation corrected-probability relative RMSE summed across both models
lower declared maximum signed arithmetic width

artifact_isolation.write_policy: new additive diagnostic files only; never write below build/w4a8-full-model-software-contract-v1 or any sealed evidence root

alternatives.calibration: For each model, layer, and Q/K head, derive one positive residual Scale32 from the frozen fit split as the smallest legal Scale32 that bounds the absolute post-projection residual divided by 7. Exact ties use the lower packed Scale32 record.
alternatives.model_specific_parameters: 24 * (14 query + 2 key) residual Scale32 records per model; 1536 bytes per model
alternatives.ptq_credibility: No retraining. Residual codes are deterministically derived from the existing projection accumulator and the unchanged c01 baseline reconstruction.
alternatives.runtime_realization: Preserve the unchanged c01 Q/K int8 projection and RoPE result as the authoritative base. Quantize signed residuals to [-7,+7], rotate them with the same RoPE coefficients, and add base-by-residual, residual-by-base, and residual-by-residual score terms before causal masking, row centering, and the unchanged softmax.
alternatives.runtime_storage: Query residuals are transient. Key residuals require a packed signed-4 sideband adjacent to the existing key-cache payload; the design report must account for exactly 64 residual bytes per token per layer before any candidate package.

alternatives.calibration: For each model, layer, Q/K head, and contiguous 8-lane group, solve deterministic non-negative least squares from c01 dequantized post-RoPE values to BF16 post-RoPE values on the frozen fit split, quantize the gain upward to legal Scale32, and use lexicographically lower packed records for exact objective ties.
alternatives.model_specific_parameters: 24 * (14 query + 2 key) * 8 group-gain Scale32 records per model; 12288 bytes per model
alternatives.ptq_credibility: No retraining and no prompt-dependent state. Only fixed calibration-derived per-model metadata is added.
alternatives.runtime_realization: Apply positive Scale32 gains to contiguous 8-lane Q/K groups after the unchanged c01 RoPE coding and before the dot-product reduction. Accumulate all eight group partial products in a declared wide signed accumulator, then perform the unchanged causal mask, centering, Q6.9 realization, and softmax.
alternatives.runtime_storage: No KV residual sideband. Gain metadata is read-only and model-specific; the design report must state the exact accumulator-width bound before any candidate package.

calibration_protocol.input_contract: The existing model-specific C4 validation records 0..63, canonical chat wrapping, and token limit 512 from the frozen software contract. Capture only Q/K projection, post-RoPE, centered score, and ideal-softmax tensors; do not generate continuation text.

implementation_objective: Compare exactly two deterministic PTQ-credible Q/K score realizations for Base and checkpoint-176 using only frozen diagnostic and model-specific calibration inputs, then select at most one shared runtime topology whose model-specific metadata satisfies the pre-softmax rank-margin invariant before any candidate package exists.

create, execute, score, or name an official or candidate attempt
write beneath any path component named candidate or attempt
generate continuation text or access generation validators, quality sets, or hidden outputs
retrain, fine-tune, distill, or change model weights

run synthesis, timing, area, PPA, FPGA emulation, bitstream generation, or board execution

shared_runtime_invariant.implementable_statement: For every valid causal attention row, the corrected integer score path must preserve the BF16 top-key index and keep centered score/probability error below the frozen TRACKING thresholds before invoking the unchanged Q0.15 softmax realization.
shared_runtime_invariant.placement: after Q/K RoPE realization and before causal row centering, Q6.9 score realization, and softmax
